definition: to transport people from one place to another
description: A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.

de.answer: Sie filmt Kängurus, die über die Ebene hüpfen.
de.question: Was filmt die Frau?

es.answer: Está filmando canguros que saltan por la llanura.
es.question: ¿Qué está filmando la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle filme des kangourous qui bondissent à travers la plaine.
fr.question: Que filme la femme ?
